cards.card_text: David asks the LORD to take up His shield and buckler.
cards.verse_text: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
cards.snippet: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

cards.card_text: God says the people in Israel's cities will go out to all the weapons Gog's army leaves behind: bucklers and shields, bows and arrows, clubs and spears.
cards.verse_text: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons—the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears.
cards.snippet: …of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons—the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears.
